inputs.text: Rs 2,000 a month for women, Rs 8,000 in household coupons and free motor pumpsets for farmers may ease pressure now, with more support for fishermen and jobs also on the table. But handouts are no substitute for families, steady work and livelihoods people can sustain with dignity. A government should help citizens stand on their own feet, not make them dependent on political promises. FDI and AI should strengthen the country and its people—not be treated as ends in themselves or allowed to displace the interests of ordinary families and local enterprise.
